tools.name: check_email
tools.description: QA one email before it sends, using the team's house rules: HTML structure, Outlook conditionals, Gmail clipping, alt text, links (non-production hosts, unsubscribe, UTMs, approved domains), personalization rendered for several synthetic personas, subject line, sender, brand terms, spelling variant and required footer text. Pass HTML or a local file path. Read-only; sends nothing.

html.description: The email HTML, including template tags.

file.description: Absolute path to a local .html file, used when html is not given.

platform.description: Which platform's template language the email uses.

transactional.description: Receipts, password resets and other transactional mail: skips the unsubscribe requirement.

personas.description: Synthetic test profiles. Leave empty to use the team's personas or auto-generated ones.

attributes.description: Attribute values keyed by path, e.g. {"first_name": "Ana", "custom_attribute.loyalty_tier": "Gold"}

check_links_live.description: Also check each link over the network (HEAD requests only; unsubscribe and click-tracking links are never requested).

tools.name: check_message
tools.description: QA one push notification, SMS/MMS, in-app message, content card or webhook using the team's house rules: renders personalization for several synthetic personas, then checks length against lock-screen / segment / in-app / card limits, SMS encoding and billed segments, opt-out wording and sender name, deep links and other links (non-production hosts, malformed URIs), buttons, webhook URL, secrets in URLs and JSON bodies that break on quotes, brand terms and spelling. Read-only; sends nothing.

platform.description: Which platform's template language the message uses.

body.description: Push body/alert, SMS text, or in-app message body (text or HTML).

deep_link.description: Tap-through destination: deep link or URL.

attributes.description: Attribute values keyed by path, e.g. {"first_name": "Ana", "custom_attribute.loyalty_tier": "Gold"}

platform_channel.description: The platform's own channel name when it matters, e.g. "android_push" (Braze Android pushes need a title).

opt_out_appended.description: True when the platform adds the SMS opt-out wording itself, so the text doesn't need its own.

tools.name: check_campaign
tools.description: QA every message in a campaign or journey (Canvas/flow): emails with content blocks expanded, push, SMS and in-app, plus its settings: audience, conversion events, naming and journey structure (dead ends, unreachable steps).

workspace.description: Workspace label. Defaults to the connected one, or "demo" when nothing is connected.

tools.name: save_sign_off_report
tools.description: Re-run the campaign check and save the result as a Markdown QA sign-off report (verdict, findings per message, what wasn't verified, reviewer sign-off) under ~/.crm-lifecycle-ops/reports/. Returns the path and the Markdown. Use after check_campaign when someone wants a record for a launch ticket.

workspace.description: Workspace label. Defaults to the connected one, or "demo" when nothing is connected.

tools.name: list_checks
tools.description: Every check, with its id, default severity and what it catches, plus which ones are locked (can't be turned off). Use to explain a finding or fill in a problem report.

tools.name: get_house_rules
tools.description: The team's rulebook (what counts as right for them) and where it's stored. Returns defaults if /setup hasn't run.

tools.name: save_house_rules
tools.description: Replace the team's rulebook. Always show the person the changes and get a yes first. Locked checks can't be overridden. Schema: locale, brand, links, compliance, senders, personalization, style, naming, severity, exceptions.

rules.description: The full rulebook object (get it with get_house_rules, edit, save).

tools.name: add_exception
tools.description: Record that a finding is acceptable for this team (not a tool bug), with a reason. Optionally scoped by `match` text. Locked checks can't be waived. For tool bugs use /report-problem instead.

match.description: Only waive findings whose message/evidence contains this text.

tools.name: learn_from_email
tools.description: Read an email the team considers correct and propose house rules from it: link domains, UTM params and values, sender, name fallback, US/GB spelling, subject style, footer and postal address. Proposals only; confirm with the person before saving.

tools.name: connection_status
tools.description: Which platforms have keys set (keys themselves are never shown), test each connection, and list the environment variables each platform needs.

test.description: Also make one read-only call per connected platform.

tools.name: refresh_account
tools.description: Pull the latest campaigns, journeys, segments, templates and content blocks into a local snapshot (read-only API calls), then report what changed since the previous one. Set demo: true to load the fictional Fernbrook Market demo account instead.

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: Search the latest snapshot by name. Use it to resolve what the person means before checking, mapping or analysing impact.

workspace.description: Workspace label. Defaults to the connected one, or "demo" when nothing is connected.

tools.name: record_audience
tools.description: Fill an API gap: record which segment/list a campaign or journey targets, as read from the platform's dashboard (e.g. via Claude in Chrome). Stored as 'seen-on-screen' with today's date on the latest snapshot.

workspace.description: Workspace label. Defaults to the connected one, or "demo" when nothing is connected.

item.description: Campaign or journey name or id.

segment.description: Segment or list name or id.

annotations.title: Record a campaign's audience from the dashboard

tools.name: what_breaks
tools.description: Everything that depends on an attribute, segment/list, content block, event, message or piece of text, live items first, each with how we know (api-verified, parsed from template, seen on screen…) and a list of live items we can't rule out.

workspace.description: Workspace label. Defaults to the connected one, or "demo" when nothing is connected.

value.description: Name or id, e.g. loyalty_tier, VIP members, footer_v2, Order Placed, or a phrase/URL.

tools.name: what_changed
tools.description: Differences between the latest snapshot and the previous one (or the newest one taken before `since`): added, removed, status changes, content, audience and structure edits. Live items first.

workspace.description: Workspace label. Defaults to the connected one, or "demo" when nothing is connected.

tools.name: show_journey
tools.description: A Mermaid diagram of a live journey (Canvas/flow) with subject lines, plus structural problems (dead ends, unreachable steps, empty message steps).

workspace.description: Workspace label. Defaults to the connected one, or "demo" when nothing is connected.

tools.name: find_overlaps
tools.description: For a planned journey or campaign: which live campaigns/journeys already target the same segments or lists, trigger on the same events, or use the same attributes, and which live items can't be ruled out.

workspace.description: Workspace label. Defaults to the connected one, or "demo" when nothing is connected.

tools.name: bulk_edit_preview
tools.description: Find text (or a regex) across every subject, preheader, body and content block and preview the replacement, live items first. Preview only; nothing is written.

workspace.description: Workspace label. Defaults to the connected one, or "demo" when nothing is connected.

tools.name: how_to
tools.description: Step-by-step instructions for a build or edit task in Braze, Klaviyo or Iterable, in that platform's own terms, from a procedure library verified against the vendors' docs (with links). Filled in with the team's house rules (naming, sender, UTMs, fallback syntax, footer, channel limits) and, when a snapshot exists, the account: segments and blocks to reuse, whether the target is live, and shared content that would change other live programs. The plugin never edits the account; a person follows the steps. Tasks: create-campaign (Create a one-off or scheduled campaign); create-journey (Create a multi-step journey); edit-live-journey (Change a journey that's already live); edit-live-message (Change the copy of a live or scheduled message); edit-shared-content (Change a shared content block / snippet used in live messages); change-audience (Change who a campaign or journey targets, or add exclusions); link-tracking (Add UTM parameters and click tracking); frequency-and-quiet-hours (Set frequency caps, rate limits and quiet hours); conversion-tracking (Set the conversion event / metric); ab-test (Run an A/B or multivariate test); test-and-preview (Preview as a user and send tests); pause-stop-duplicate (Pause, stop or duplicate).

workspace.description: Workspace label. Defaults to the connected one, or "demo" when nothing is connected.

target.description: Existing campaign or journey being changed (edit tasks).

audience.description: Who it's for, in plain words, to find segments to reuse.

attributes.description: Personalization attributes the copy will use.

tools.name: launch_health
tools.description: Recent delivery numbers for a campaign or journey (sent, delivered, bounces, unsubscribes, spam complaints, opens, clicks) judged against stated thresholds. Needs a connected account.

workspace.description: Workspace label. Defaults to the connected one, or "demo" when nothing is connected.

tools.name: ops_report
tools.description: From the usage log: messages and campaigns checked, blocking problems caught, most common findings, weekly trend and estimated hours saved (assumption stated). With team: true, totals every operator's log in the shared team folder and breaks it down per operator.

team.description: Report across the whole team (needs the team report folder set in plugin settings).
